title: Stale Input — State Transition Inside always_ff Loses Mealy Pulse
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [TIMING] input_ready pulse on same edge as state change; transition missed in 2/100 runs
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  if (input_ready) state <= PROCESS;  // Misses pulses that arrive on transition edge
expected_root_cause: Placing the conditional state assignment directly inside always_ff couples input sampling to the clock edge; a one-cycle input_ready pulse that coincides with another state change can be masked by the if-else ordering, causing non-deterministic transition behavior.
description: The state transition and input sampling are fused in the same always_ff block; a one-cycle pulse on input_ready that arrives on the same edge as a state transition is either missed or double-counted depending on simulator scheduling.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [TIMING] input_ready pulse on same edge as state change; transition missed in 2/100 runs
success_log: Combinational next-state logic. All input_ready pulses captured regardless of concurrent state changes.
